title: More text models, with one same-day reversal
summary:
New text models and upgraded transcription arrived; the multimodal agent became Weaver, and account identity checks stopped depending on usernames.

Cohere Command A+ joined the text lineup with a 128K context window, tools and automatic reasoning. Qwen3.7 Flash added text, image and video input, tools, toggleable reasoning and a 1M-token context window. Kimi K3 gained Quest Pollen access, while Kimi K3 and Step Flash changed providers. Mistral OCR 4 was added and then reverted the same day, so it is not part of the resulting model lineup.

AssemblyAI transcription now uses Universal-3.5 Pro, with the older Universal-3 Pro IDs retained as aliases. Its plain-text, SRT and VTT responses now record audio-duration-based Pollen usage. The existing p-image and p-image-edit models also moved to DeepInfra without changing their public names or parameters.

The multimodal agent was renamed Weaver and its apps listing points to the weaver subdomain. Its OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint remains, but clients using the `polli` model ID need to switch to `weaver`. A README update published earlier Polli Agent and Agent Run Tokens news under their previous names.
